definition_quote.value: The practice of dietetics and nutrition means the integration and application of scientific principles derived from the study of food, nutrition, biochemistry, metabolism, nutrigenomics, physiology, food management, and from behavioral and social sciences in achieving and maintaining health throughout the life span and in providing nutrition care services, including medical nutrition therapy, for the prevention, management, and treatment of disease.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of dietetics and nutrition" means the integration and application of scientific principles derived from the study of food, nutrition, biochemistry, metabolism, nutrigenomics, physiology, food management, and from behavioral and social sciences in achieving and maintaining health throughout the life span and in providing nutrition care services, including medical nutrition therapy, for the prevention, management, and treatment of disease.

value: monitoring and evaluation of nutrition care plans
nutrition support including ordering of parenteral and enteral nutrition
dietary and nutritional counseling and education
development and administration of nutrition care standards and systems
ordering laboratory tests to check and track nutrition status
methods_authorized.quote: This term includes, but is not limited to, nutrition assessment; nutrition diagnosis; nutrition intervention; monitoring and evaluation of nutrition care plans; nutrition support, including the ordering of parenteral and enteral nutrition; dietary and nutritional counseling and education, including regarding food, nutrient and prescription drug interactions; and the development and administration of nutrition care standards and systems.

drug_authority.value: Licensed dietitian nutritionists may order enteral and parenteral nutrition (specialized solutions) if they are also a CDR-registered dietitian nutritionist, a Certified Nutrition Support Clinician, or meet other competency requirements. They may not otherwise prescribe drugs.
drug_authority.quote: Enteral and parenteral nutrition therapy consist of specialized enteral or intravenous solutions and shall only be ordered by an individual licensed under P.L.2019, c.331 (C.45:16B-1 et al.) who also meets one of the following criteria: (1) the individual is a registered dietitian nutritionist registered with the Commission on Dietetic Registration; (2) the individual is a Certified Nutrition Support Clinician certified by the National Board of Nutrition Support Certification

license_type_structure.quote: "Licensed dietitian nutritionist" means a person who is licensed as a licensed dietitian nutritionist pursuant to the provisions of P.L.2019, c.331 (C.45:16B-1 et al.). "Licensed nutritionist" means a person who is licensed as a licensed nutritionist pursuant to the provisions of P.L.2019, c.331 (C.45:16B-1 et al.).

provisional_license_available.quote: the board shall issue a temporary license to a person who has applied for licensure pursuant to P.L.2019, c.331 (C.45:16B-1 et al.) and who, in the judgment of the board, is eligible for examination.

provisional_license_requires_supervision.quote: A temporary license shall be available to an applicant with the applicant's initial application for examination and the applicant may practice only under the supervision of a supervisor specified in section 9 of P.L.2019, c.331 (C.45:16B-9), consistent with State law.

dietetic_technician_recognized.quote: prohibit a nutrition and dietetic technician from providing nutrition services under the supervision of a licensed dietitian nutritionist or licensed nutritionist

rd_credential_accepted_in_lieu_of_state_.quote: provide evidence of current, valid registration as a registered dietitian nutritionist with the Commission on Dietetic Registration

value: Certified Nutrition Specialist (Board for Certification of Nutrition Specialists)

alternative_credential_pathways.quote: the applicant has either a valid current certification with the Board for Certification of Nutrition Specialists that gives the applicant the right to use the term "Certified Nutrition Specialist" or "CNS" or a valid current certification with the American Clinical Board of Nutrition that gives the applicant the right to use the term "Diplomate, American Clinical Board of Nutrition" or "DACBN."

medical_nutrition_therapy_authorized.quote: "Medical nutrition therapy" means the provision of nutrition care services for the intended purpose of treatment or management of a diagnosed disease or medical condition.

enteral_parenteral_nutrition_authorized.quote: nutrition support, including the ordering of parenteral and enteral nutrition

diet_order_writing_authority.quote: A licensed dietitian nutritionist or licensed nutritionist may order patient diets, including therapeutic diets, in accordance with the provisions of P.L.2019, c.331 (C.45:16B-1 et al.).

lab_test_ordering_authority.quote: ordering laboratory tests to check and track nutrition status and monitor effectiveness of dietary plans and orders

physician_referral_required.quote: A licensed dietitian nutritionist or licensed nutritionist may accept or transmit oral, verbal, delegated, or electronically transmitted orders from the referring provider consistent with applicable laws and rules in conjunction with protocols established to implement medical nutrition therapy.

diagnosis_treatment_prohibition.quote: The practice of dietetics and nutrition does not include the medical differential diagnosis of the health status of an individual.

telehealth_practice_authorized.quote: Any health care provider who uses telemedicine or engages in telehealth while providing health care services to a patient, shall: (1) be validly licensed, certified, or registered, pursuant to Title 45 of the Revised Statutes, to provide such services in the State of New Jersey

exempt_professions_list.quote: nothing in P.L.2019, c.331 (C.45:16B-1 et al.) shall be construed to: (1) prohibit a person licensed to practice pursuant to Title 45 of the Revised Statutes from engaging in the practice or teaching of dietetics and nutrition within the scope of that person's license

federal_employee_exemption.quote: prohibit any person from practicing dietetics and nutrition within the scope of the person's official duties when employed by a department, agency, bureau, division, or other unit of the federal government, serving in the Armed Forces of the United States, or employed by any State institution or facility

weight_control_program_exemption.quote: prohibit any person providing medical weight control from doing so through a program of instruction that has been approved in writing by a licensed dietitian nutritionist or licensed nutritionist in this State

food_supplement_sales_exemption.quote: prohibit any person who does not hold himself or herself out to be a licensed dietitian nutritionist or licensed nutritionist from furnishing nutrition information, providing evaluation, guidance, information, and education as to the use of food, food materials, or dietary supplements, or from engaging in the explanation to persons as to the use of food or food products including dietary supplements

nonresident_temporary_practice_allowed.quote: the board may issue without examination a temporary license authorizing one to provide medical nutrition therapy and to hold oneself out as a dietitian nutritionist or nutritionist in this State to a person who provides evidence that the person is in the State on a temporary basis to assist in a medical emergency or engage in a special project or teaching assignment relating to the practice of dietetics and nutrition
